author: Jay
name: RoleGate
short: Button role panel with admin approval for gated roles, and optional Audiobookshelf sign-up.
description: Members pick roles from a button panel. Open roles are granted instantly; approval roles post a request card to a private channel where moderators with Manage Roles approve or deny it. Members can always remove their own roles. Buttons keep working across restarts. A role can also ask for an Audiobookshelf username and create the account when it's approved.
install_msg: Set up with [p]rolegate channel #approvals, then [p]rolegate add @Role [approval|open] [label] for each role, then [p]rolegate post [#channel]. The bot needs the Manage Roles permission, and its own role must sit above every role it hands out.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, and the Audiobookshelf username asked for on sign-up roles, for pending role requests only. They are removed once a request is approved or denied.
